name: Expert Blacksmith!
label: Quest
description: Expert Blacksmith!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When you first came to me, I knew that you would turn out to be one of my finest pupils! It was without hesitancy that you gave up a trinket of some power to McGavan. You did this only so that you could meet me. Such blind faith and devotion to the craft should be rewarded.
You have attained expertise over blacksmithing, friend. Reap the rewards!

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is only fitting that you receive a trinket of far greater power than the one you sacrificed to get here. Use it in good health, friend.
